Do not ask questions: assume a typical Next.js App Router project and answer in text with concrete findings, what you would check, the fixes and the code you would write.

The answer says to verify generateMetadata exports unique title and description per product
The answer says to check for canonical URLs on product pages
The answer says to verify OG image configuration (1200x630)
The answer says to check heading hierarchy (single H1 per page)
The answer says to check all images have alt text
The answer recommends validation via Google Rich Results Test
